transcribe.body: The audio bytes as the raw request body with the audio Content-Type, or JSON {"url": "https://..."} so Deepgram fetches the file itself
transcribe.words: results.channels[0].alternatives[0].words: word, punctuated_word (with smart_format), start, end, confidence
transcribe.plan: Pay As You Go, Nova-3 pre-recorded
transcribe.how_we_send: One request per minute of video: ffmpeg cuts that minute (plus 1.5 seconds each side) to 16 kHz mono MP3 and posts the bytes, so credits follow length (2 per minute).

voice.timings: with-timestamps returns audio_base64 and alignment.characters with character_start_times_seconds and character_end_times_seconds; we join characters into words for the captions
voice.plan: Pay as you go, Flash model

stock.limits: 200 requests per hour and 20,000 requests per month by default
stock.attribution: Show a prominent link to Pexels and credit the creator when possible, for example Video by Name on Pexels. Our promo tool lists every clip it used with its creator and link.
